rows.note: Repair names one step, consequence first, after each break: removed member -> 'The story expects people who are not in this chat... Missing from the group: Lady Corvane' (stayed the one step with a muted member and a dropped book also broken); then the muted member, then 'Nothing is missing.' But after /member-add the row stayed (requirements still listed her) until an unrelated World Info change refreshed them; no reveal control, only Fix with wizard.

Fix with wizard (settings Repair and the drawer's author panel) seeds 'cast members that do not exist yet: Lady Corvane; lorebooks that do not exist yet: The Redline Kingdom' although both exist (removed from the group / deselected). The provisioning stage answered 'Nothing needs creating, no ops emitted': it cannot re-add a member, unmute one or reselect a book, so it fixed nothing (it also created nothing extra and no persona). Fixed by hand with /member-add, /world, /member-enable.

Known finding no longer holds: disabling Lord Vael put him in requirements.mutedMembers, the drawer author panel listed 'Unmuted cast - Missing: Lord Vael', and once the worse gaps were fixed Repair named it: 'Lord Vael is muted in this group, so the story cannot give them a turn. ... Unmute this member in the group's member list.' While a member was missing Repair showed only that (one step). requirements.ready stays true with a muted member.
